name: redis-shared-memory-editor
description: Capture private work, promote confirmed organizational state, and use shared Redis Agent Memory and Playbook.

interface.shortDescription: Capture privately, promote with consent, and prepare governed agendas.
interface.longDescription: A local MCP integration for multiple users and their agents to capture session events in private Redis Agent Memory namespaces, explicitly promote source-linked organizational state to one shared namespace, read reconciled management state, and load approved Redis Agent Playbook content. Each user keeps service credentials and participant attribution in a private local file.
defaultPrompt: Check the Redis Shared Memory connection status.
Search shared memory before answering this question.
Find the current source-grounded management state for this project.
Prepare a cited management review agenda for the next meeting.
Show my pending private memory candidates and their evidence.
Publish this user-approved fact to shared memory.
